headline: Clinton order directs federal agencies to focus on environmental health and safety risks that affect children.
what_it_does: This executive order tells federal agencies to pay special attention to health and safety risks from the environment that may affect children more than adults. Children can be more exposed or more sensitive to things like pollution. The order asks agencies to consider these risks in their policies and rules. Only the title was provided, so the details here are limited.

who_it_affects.how: Federal health and safety policies are meant to take children's special risks into account.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that set environmental and safety rules
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to weigh how their rules and programs may affect children's health and safety.
